extractions.content: How does one define a small language model?
What are the outputs of a language model that can be used to improve itself?
The improvements must be made using only the language model's own outputs.
How can the language model learn to generate better outputs only from its own generated outputs?
What are the potential risks or limitations of this approach for improving the language model?
